reason: This plugin is primarily a data-processing utility for session feedback: it aggregates local session event-log metrics into a deterministic roast/toast recap, exposes those figures via a host projection, and shows them in a web composer card for user viewing and copy actions.

summaries.zh: 该插件会基于当前会话日志中的轮次、步骤、工具调用等数字生成中文复盘，并通过模型可见工具与客户端浮窗展示，可切换毒舌或鼓励语气并复制结果。
summaries.en: This plugin generates a deterministic Chinese session recap from local event-log metrics, exposes it through a model tool and web projection, and shows it in a composer floating card with roast/toast mode switching and copy support.

capabilities: Reads and aggregates local session event-log data (turns, steps, tool calls, tool failures, output tokens)
Generates deterministic recap text in Chinese in roast/toast modes from aggregated metrics
Publishes recap figures via a host projection for client consumption
Displays a web composer floating card and supports text copy actions

reasons.code: The plugin describes itself as folding current session logs into recap metrics (turns, steps, tool calls, failures, output tokens) and rendering deterministic Chinese recap text.
A model-visible `viper_recap` tool and a `viperRecap` projection are provided, with a composer 🐍 button opening a floating recap card.
The README states recap text is computed from local session numbers with no extra model call or API-key use, indicating no external inference dependency for generation.
Package metadata declares a web client entry (`./client`) under `dsh.client.platform`, matching the documented composer UI behavior.
